quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.hint: You can also press the Esc key two times fast to leave.

resources.heading: Free help from an advocate
resources.intro: Advocates help people who are asking for a protection order. They can talk with you about your options. Their help is free and private.
resources.none: Contacts for advocates are being added. Please check back soon.

timeout.heading: Are you still here?
timeout.body: To protect your privacy, everything you typed will be cleared in {seconds} seconds.

start.heading: Get your story ready to file
start.intro: ReadyFile gets the incidents part of your protection order petition ready (question 8 on the court's form). When you finish, you copy it into the court's online form. It asks the kind of questions court staff ask in person.
start.notFiling: This tool does not file anything for you. It does not give legal advice.
start.safetyNote: If someone else uses this device, they may see what you type. Nothing is saved. To leave fast, use Quick exit at the top of the screen. Everything is cleared after {minutes} minutes with no activity.
start.groundsLegend: What happened? Check every one that applies.
start.groundsHint: This is question 1 on the court's form. If you are not sure, leave them all unchecked. You can still finish.

grounds.sex-offense: A sex offense, like sexual assault

start.relationshipLabel: How do you know this person?
start.relationshipHint: The court's form asks this (question 2). It helps show which kind of order fits. You can skip it.

relationships.lived-together: We lived together in an intimate relationship
relationships.dating: We are dating or used to date
relationships.sexual: We have or had a sexual relationship
relationships.blood-adoption: We are related by blood or adoption
relationships.marriage: We are or were related by marriage, like a stepparent or in-law
relationships.guardian: The person is or was my guardian
relationships.ward: The person is or was my ward (I was their guardian)
relationships.custodian: The person is or was my custodian
relationships.foster-parent: The person is or was my foster parent
relationships.minor-child-of: I am the minor child of someone with one of these relationships to the person
relationships.none: None of these, like a neighbor, coworker, or stranger
relationships.not-sure: Not sure, or I'd rather not say

story.heading: Your story
story.intro: Now write what happened in your own words. You can write about what led up to these times and how it affected you. This part is optional. You do not have to repeat the dates.
story.label: Your story in your own words
story.hint: Write as much or as little as you want.
story.threatLabel: Do you think this person could hurt you now? (optional)
story.threatHint: What makes you think so? For example: threats they made, past violence, weapons, or that they keep showing up. The court looks at whether the danger is real today, not only in the past.
story.askedToStopLabel: Did you ever tell this person to stop contacting you?
story.askedToStopDetailLabel: When and how did you tell them? (optional)
story.askedToStopDetailHint: For example: I texted him on March 2 to leave me alone.
story.convictedLabel: Was this person convicted of a sex crime against you? (optional)
story.convictedHint: Criminal charges are not needed to ask for an order. If the person was convicted and must register as a sex or violent offender for life, the order can last with no end date.

organize.heading: Add your incidents
organize.intro: An incident is one time something happened. Add each one with the date, if you know it. Short notes are fine.
organize.empty: There are no incidents yet. You can add one below.
organize.sampleNote: Demo only. These buttons do not appear in the real tool.

incident.heading: Incident {n}
incident.approximateHint: For example: early March, or the week before Thanksgiving.
incident.placeHint: For example: my home, the parking lot at work, or online on Instagram.
incident.evidenceHint: For example: screenshots, photos, or a police report. Bring these to court.
incident.reorderHint: To change the order, use Move up and Move down, or drag on a computer. Each incident has the same number on every step and in your summary.
incident.futureHint: This date is after today. Please check it.
incident.actsHint: Check all that fit (question 7 on the court's form).

acts.placed-in-fear: Made me afraid I would be hurt
acts.forced-sexual: Forced me into sexual activity by force, threats, or pressure
acts.sex-offense: Committed a sex offense against me
acts.animal-cruelty: Hurt or killed an animal to scare or control me
acts.sex-grooming: Contacted a child again and again to prepare them for sexual activity (sex grooming)

incident.presentHint: List everyone who was there. The court's form asks you to include your own name if you were there.
incident.firsthandLabel: Did you see or hear this yourself?

firsthandOptions.no: No, someone told me about it

incident.firsthandNote: If you did not see or hear it yourself, the court needs a signed statement (an affidavit) from someone who did.
incident.feelingLabel: How did it make you feel? (optional)
incident.feelingHint: For example: scared, threatened, or afraid to go home.

check.heading: A few questions
check.intro: Court staff often ask questions like these when they help someone fill out the form. You can see all of them here. Open one to answer it, or skip it. For each one, you can add more or continue as is. It is your choice.
check.totalNone: There are no questions right now.
check.resolved: What you added answered the question you came from, so it is no longer on this list.
check.aboutRelationship: About how you know this person
check.matchesHint: The marked text may be contact details. Nothing is changed unless you change it.

review.heading: Review your incidents
review.notFiling: This tool does not file your petition. To file, copy this summary into the court's online form, or print it.
review.order: Here, incidents with a full date (day, month, and year) are shown first, from oldest to newest, and the others after. Your summary keeps the order of your list.
review.copyFailed: Could not copy. You can select the summary and copy it yourself.
review.clipboardNote: Copied text stays on this device until you copy something else. If others use this device, you may want to copy something else when you are done.
review.clearQuestion: Clear everything you typed and start over?
review.formHeading: The rest of the court's form
review.formIntro: The court's forms ask for more than your incidents. On the next step, ReadyFile asks for the rest and prints everything on the official forms:
formItems: The petition (PO-0100): the court and the people in the case, other court cases (question 4), why you are filing in this county (question 5), your public mailing address (question 6), and what you are asking the judge to order (question 9).
The Confidential Form (PO-0104): what you know about the other person, your private contact details, and other people to protect. Police use it to serve and enforce the order.
The Notice of Exclusion (PNW-0102), which keeps the Confidential Form private. ReadyFile fills it in from your other answers.
You sign and date the petition by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury that what you wrote is true.
review.formHarassment: Because you checked only harassment: if your petition is based on harassment alone, the court must notify the person and hold a hearing before it can order anything.
review.formSource: Based on the Indiana petition (PO-0100), its instructions (PO-0102), the Confidential Form (PO-0104), and the Notice of Exclusion (PNW-0102).
review.formSexOffense: Because you checked a sex offense: if the person was convicted and must register as a sex or violent offender for life, question 2 asks for the case number, the court and state, and the date of conviction.

summary.title: Incident summary
summary.groundsNotSure: Grounds for the order (question 1): not sure yet
summary.firsthandNo: I did not see or hear this myself. A signed statement from someone who did is needed.
summary.threat: Why I think this person could hurt me now:
summary.askedToStop: I told this person to stop contacting me: {answer}
summary.attachmentNote: The form has room for 3 incidents. Write incidents 4 and up on a separate page labeled Attachment 8a, attach it, and count it in question 10 (number of pages attached).
summary.convicted: The person was convicted of a sex crime against me. If they must register for life, the order can last with no end date (question 2).

badges.heading: Questions that may come up
badges.summary: Court staff may ask these on the Questions step. Number of questions: {count}. Choose one to add details now. The number goes down as you add details.
badges.summaryNone: No questions are expected for this list.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.empty: Incidents will show here once you add them.

announce.added: Added a new incident. You now have {count}.
announce.deleted: Incident deleted. You now have {count}. Undo is available for a few seconds.
announce.merged: Incidents merged. You now have {count}. Undo is available for a few seconds.
announce.undone: Done. Your change was undone. You now have {count}.

safety.heading: Safety questions
safety.intro: These questions are optional. Your answers are shown to court staff as you give them. They do not change whether your petition is accepted.

route.heading: Your situation
route.intro: A few questions pick the court forms that fit. Nothing is saved, and you can go back at any time.

filledBy.next-friend: You fill this in for the child
filledBy.server: The person who serves the papers fills this in

route.notFilledYet: ReadyFile does not fill these forms in yet. The court clerk's office has them, and an advocate can help you with them for free.

forms.heading: Court forms
forms.intro: These questions follow the court's forms, section by section. Your answers are printed on the official forms. Only fill in what you know.
forms.private: Only the court, the clerk, the prosecutor, and police see this.
forms.fitsOnForm: {max} fit on the form. Any more go on Attachment {label}, which is added for you.
forms.limitReached: The court can list up to {limit} people in one order. More need a second petition.
forms.downloadIntro: ReadyFile prints your answers on the court's official forms. The PDFs are made on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere. There are two files, because the Confidential Form must never be printed with the petition.
forms.missingIntro: These are needed for the forms. You can still make the PDF and fill them in by hand.
forms.complete: Everything the forms need is filled in.
forms.failed: The PDF could not be made. Please try again.
forms.afterDownload: The PDFs are not saved in ReadyFile. If someone else uses this device, delete them from your downloads when you are done, especially the Confidential Form.
forms.publicHeading: 1. The petition and Notice of Exclusion
forms.publicIntro: The petition is a public court record, and one copy is given to the other person.
forms.madePublic: The petition PDF is ready. Check your downloads.
forms.confidentialIntro: This has your home address and other private details. Only the court, the clerk, the prosecutor, and police see it. Print one copy, give it only to the clerk, and never put it with the copies of the petition.
forms.madeConfidential: The Confidential Form PDF is ready. Check your downloads.
forms.publicTitle: Your petition: before you file (do not file this page)
publicInstructions: This file has the petition and the Notice of Exclusion, with your answers printed on them. The Confidential Form is in a separate file. Do not print it with this one.
Read every page, and fix anything that is wrong by hand or in ReadyFile.
Sign and date the petition by hand. You sign it under penalty of perjury. Some courts ask you to sign in front of the clerk, so you can wait until you file.
Print 4 copies of the petition and 3 copies of the Notice of Exclusion (PNW-0102). One copy of the petition is given to the other person.
Take everything to the clerk's office in the county where you are filing. There is no fee to file a petition for an order for protection.
The clerk fills in the case number, the court's room, and the cover sheet. Leave those blank.
If you based the petition on what others told you, attach sworn statements (affidavits) from the people who saw or heard it.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
forms.confidentialTitle: CONFIDENTIAL: Confidential Form (PO-0104). Do not serve on the Respondent.
confidentialInstructions: This file has the Confidential Form with your private details. It is confidential under Indiana law (Ind. Code 5-2-9-7). Only the court, the clerk, the prosecutor, and police see it.
Print 1 copy. Print page 2 on green paper if you can (Admin. Rule 9).
Give it only to the clerk, with your petition. Never staple it to a copy of the petition, and never give it to the other person.
The red line at the top and bottom of each page is from ReadyFile. It is there so this page is never mixed with the petition by mistake.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
forms.confidentialBanner: CONFIDENTIAL (Ind. Code 5-2-9-7) - GIVE ONLY TO THE CLERK - DO NOT SERVE ON THE RESPONDENT

start.relationshipLabel: How does this person know the child?
